name: branding-cat-eared-portfolio-title-with-avatar-illustration
title: Portfolio cover with orange display letters, cat-ear Os and an illustrated avatar
whatItIs: A white cover where the word PORTFOLIO is set in chunky orange letters with the two O's turned into cat-faced characters. Above is 'Graphic designer', with '2026' at the right. Below a cropped blue-haired illustrated avatar with big eyes fills the centre, and name and phone sit at the base.
whatItMeans: Bright, cute and confident; the character makes the designer memorable.
techniques: Pair chunky orange type with a blue-haired illustration for complementary colour.
Crop the avatar so it appears to peek into the frame.
Use tiny captions at the corners.

vocabulary.definition: A letter redrawn as a face or creature.
Blue and orange used together for contrast.
A character partially cut by the frame.
